scope: Static contract only; no implementation, permission change, retry, test, state call or comparison cell.
bound_requirements: Target reservation without placing a placeholder at final
FlushFileBuffers on each affected file handle
Reject partial, foreign, readable-only or unconfirmed publication
Fail closed on missing rights and every intermediate operation error

namespace.directories: Pre-existing, identity-bound and durability-accepted; never created by publisher.
namespace.study_reservation: durable_ledger_root / study_id; CREATE_NEW file; any existing object including legacy directory rejects
namespace.target_reservation: final + '.reservation.json'; permanent and target-specific, not a final-file placeholder
namespace.staging: Existing source-bound staging role, same parent as final
namespace.cell_and_journal_records: Flat in durable_ledger_root, study_id + '.' + existing evidence basename
namespace.completion_marker: final + '.completed.json'; sole physical representation of journal entry 114
identity_requirements: No reparses, alternate streams, ambiguous aliases or unexpected hardlinks
namespace.legacy_compatibility: Existing reservation object always blocks; no automatic migration or reset

file_operations.rights: GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE on owned writable files; DELETE additionally only on staging handle for rename
file_operations.sharing: Deny third-party writes and deletes; verifier handles must remain compatible with owner access
file_operations.write_contract: Finite predeclared requests and lengths; every request must return the full requested byte count. Short write is terminal, not repaired.
file_operations.barrier: FlushFileBuffers on the same affected file handle; immediate return/error capture
file_operations.rename: One SetFileInformationByHandle with FileRenameInfo and ReplaceIfExists=False on retained staging handle
file_operations.post_rename: Flush the same retained file handle and validate final name, parent, file/volume identity and complete bytes

steps.operation: Validate source, plan, authorization, platform acceptance and parent/path identities
steps.next_only_if: All prerequisites are bound and valid

steps.operation: Create study reservation; complete write; file barrier; full verification
steps.next_only_if: Reservation barrier and byte/identity checks confirmed

steps.operation: Create target sidecar reservation; complete write; file barrier; full verification
steps.next_only_if: Both reservations confirmed; no rollback if target reservation fails

steps.operation: Revalidate both reservations and namespace durability; require per-record write/barrier/verification for subsequent starts and journals
steps.next_only_if: All prerequisite evidence is durable; any future cell requires separate authorization

steps.operation: Write and flush complete staging; validate all evidence; write, flush and verify SEALED journal 113
steps.next_only_if: Staging and SEALED complete and confirmed

steps.operation: Exactly one same-volume no-replace handle rename
Post-rename barrier on retained result handle; complete final and identity validation
Create sole completion marker/journal 114; complete write; own barrier; full verification
Revalidate sources/reservations/evidence and successfully close owned handles; return once
steps.next_only_if: Both internal confirmations and all required evidence valid

completion_marker.encoding: Existing canonical JSON and SHA-256 rules; self-digest excluded from its own input
completion_marker.terminal_journal_entry: Existing AttemptJournalEntry at ordinal 114, following SEALED 113, unchanged inner reservation/artifact/chain bindings
completion_marker.source_rule: All values from validated sources or actual handle observations, never caller assertions

failure_rules.condition: Missing write or rename rights, including error 5
failure_rules.decision: Immediate failure; no elevation, fallback or retry

failure_rules.condition: Missing directory or its prerequisite evidence
Existing reservation, target or other conflicting evidence
failure_rules.decision: Reject; preserve all objects; no new identity to bypass

failure_rules.condition: Short write, write/flush/identity/content failure before rename
Uncertain rename or visible result without confirmed final barrier
Missing, partial, foreign or unflushed marker
failure_rules.decision: ABORTED_INCOMPLETE even if result is fully readable

failure_rules.condition: Loss of trusted live confirmation context
failure_rules.decision: No reconstructed operative COMPLETED; at most COMPLETE_RECORDS_PRESENT_UNCONFIRMED after read-only full validation

failure_rules.condition: Every E0-E8 requirement confirmed in the owning attempt

terminal_policy.notes: A visible marker cannot prove the return of its own final flush. No operational success is reconstructed after loss of trusted live context.

acceptance_gates.requirement: Pre-existing durable parent namespace and stable identities
Data and metadata coverage for reservation/new records and rename, without assuming a file flush covers every parent directory
Atomic no-replace visibility, file identity and share/permission behavior under failures/concurrency
Materialization of marker envelope, path mapping, ordered failures and E0-E8 confirmations
New source-bound isolated platform evidence for this backend

acceptance_order: S2-EP separate static implementation/platform pre-audit; assess materialization and evidence plan, not nonexistent implementation
Separate explicit implementation authorization, then audit actual code and isolated platform scope
Separate explicit one-shot authorization before a new isolated S2-EM platform attempt; new evidence identity, never reuse s2em.001
Collect platform evidence without real study reservation or matrix; empirical gates need not pass before their own isolated measurement
All G1-G5 accepted before study publisher use; then S2-EL and a separate matrix authorization
evidence_limits: Normative contract is not an observed platform capability.
Conditional on correctly behaving OS, NTFS, drivers and storage; no physical power-loss test.
Readable bytes do not establish durability.
Failure before successful reservation barrier cannot claim durable consumption; absence never authorizes retry.
Manual ledger deletion, rollback and malicious forgery remain outside the existing trust boundary.
